answer: Assign each submission to 3 re-executors picked by a beacon whose seed the submitter cannot predict, and require 2 of 3 matching outputs before the payout. A farm cannot pre-select friendly reviewers, so 1,000 fake agents need 1,000 honest-looking executions plus uncorrelated results, and disagreement dilutes the reward to nothing. The cost is real compute, paid upfront, with no bridge back. What happens when the beacon itself stalls before dawn?
